Candidate-set CE is −log[exp(s+/τ)/(exp(s+/τ)+Σexp(s−/τ))], with no proposal correction. Importance-corrected sampling instead estimates a specified catalog denominator: for K independent draws from q_u, use negative logits s−/τ−log(Kq_u(i)), retaining the deterministic positive once. The partition estimator can be unbiased; its logged loss/gradient generally is biased at finite K. Excluding training positives makes q_u zero there: correction cannot recover their denominator contributions, so this targets {current target}∪{unseen items}, not full-catalog softmax. TensorFlow’s sampled-softmax convention uses expected-count corrections and accidental-hit removal; state the exact estimator. [TensorFlow](https://www.tensorflow.org/api_docs/python/tf/nn/sampled_softmax_loss)

Reproducible proposed specification: K=32 or 64; uniform rejection sampling over valid item IDs, excluding padding and every user training positive; preprocessing seed=0, training seed=42, seeded workers/generators, fixed draw order. With replacement, q_u=1/M_u: retain duplicate multiplicities for importance estimation. For unique candidates, sample without replacement; denominator correction uses inclusion probability K/M_u. Simply masking duplicates changes the estimator unless corrected. Candidate-set CE may instead deduplicate/refill to K; mask target collisions and padding with −∞. Explicitly specify τ=1 as baseline, dot-product versus normalized scores, and any tuned τ. [Sampling](https://www.tensorflow.org/api_docs/python/tf/random/uniform_candidate_sampler), [collision masking](https://www.tensorflow.org/api_docs/python/tf/nn/compute_accidental_hits)

Proposed sparse implementation: aggregate training-only transitions; store sorted int64 keys source×(N+1)+destination and values. Batched searchsorted plus bounds/equality checks returns values or zero without N² storage. Full-catalog inference can scatter CSR rows into dense score batches; weighted histories can use sparse multiplication. Candidate scoring costs O(BLKd), lookup O(BLK log E); chunk embeddings to control memory. Budget feasibility requires timing representative batches. [searchsorted](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.searchsorted.html), [CSR](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/sparse.html)
